name: Skateboard Classic 2027

description.sv: Årlig skateboardtävling på Desert Vista Skate Park i Fountain Hills, Arizona — öppna klasser efter ålder (under 8 upp till 18+) plus en sponsrad klass, 90 sekunders körning per åkare.
description.en: Annual skateboarding competition at Desert Vista Skate Park in Fountain Hills, Arizona — open age divisions (under 8 through 18+) plus a sponsored division, 90-second runs per skater.

organizer: Town of Fountain Hills Parks & Recreation

source.note: IMPORTANT DATE DISCREPANCY on the source page: the page title and top 'Date:' field both say 2027, but the body-text paragraph says 'Saturday, January 30st, 2026' — that's internally inconsistent, since Jan 30 2026 is a Friday, not a Saturday, while Jan 30 2027 IS a Saturday. Went with 2027 as the logically-consistent date; double-check with the organizer (Sarah Lind, slind@fountainhillsaz.gov, 480-816-5130) if possible. Level is mixed (Open divisions by age plus a Sponsored/pro division) — set to "amateur" since that's the bulk of the event, but it's not a clean fit either way. Coordinates are Fountain Hills town-level approximations, not the exact skatepark pin.
